Cue.name: Read me
Cue.notes: Two process cues and two script cues: each process cue runs a Pure Data patch from its GO until Esc. Pick one to see its patch at the foot; GO, and the values show on it as they go by. Sensor to cues hears a light sensor at /sensor on this machine and fires the two cues in Fired by patches; Slider to desk is played on the canvas with Ctrl+E and writes to a desk listening on port 9000. The go. boxes are Go.dot's ready-made patches: open one in Pd or plugdata for its help. Sensor to cues, in a script, does what Sensor to cues does, written in JavaScript, and Sensor to cues, in Lua, the same in Lua: pick one to read it at the foot, and press ? there for how a script hears and sends.

Process.name: Sensor to cues
Slider to desk

Script.name: Sensor to cues, in a script
Sensor to cues, in Lua
Script.source:
-- The light sensor of Sensor to cues, in Lua. Steadied - each value moved a -- fifth of the way towards what the sensor says - crossing 600 on the way up -- fires Lights up and on the way down Lights down. A band of 50 around the -- line, so a light that hovers on it fires nothing twice. local line = 600 local band = 50 local steady = nil local above = false
godot.hear('/sensor/light', function (light) if steady == nil then steady = light else steady = steady + (light - steady) * 0.2 end if not above and steady > line + band then above = true godot.fire('PXSHN001') elseif above and steady < line - band then above = false godot.fire('PXDARK01') end print('light', math.floor(steady + 0.5)) end)
